note: Pay-processing job: candidate moves client money through own account and keeps a cut.
text:
Hi Casey,

Brightleaf Payments is hiring a remote Payment Processing Assistant. You will receive client payments into your personal bank account, keep 10% as your pay, and forward the rest to our overseas partners by wire. No interview needed, we hire fast.

Daniel Ross
brightleaf.payments.hr@gmail.com
